text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to earn Orfevre's trust. I want to 
become someone she can entrust her heart 
to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, I want to learn more 
about Orfevre. Starting by watching her 
daily life closely... Her days are truly 
dazzling."

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfe, we have secured a seat for 
you. Please, this way."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Today, Set A is fried chicken and Set B is 
a salad bowl. Which one would you like?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Forget it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The school store it is. Lead the way.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I've changed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
We are heading outside. Make the 
arrangements at once.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I will make a reservation right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Always surrounded by retainers, Orfevre 
stands out no matter what. Naturally, all 
sorts of chatter can be heard from around 
her...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
She's amazing as always, huh? She only 
just debuted, so how can she act so high 
and mighty?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, Lady Orfevre... So cool again 
today... I think I wanna be led around by 
the nose by her, too♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Envy, fear, jealousy... Though opinions 
are divided, stirring up such a myriad of 
intense emotions is surely part of 
Orfevre's charm.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, I can totally see why she 
acts like that. I saw Orfe-san run the 
other day, and... it was incredible.”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
That kind of form right after debut... 
Like she's completely flawless? No wonder 
she's so confident.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While she shows some immaturity typical of 
the Junior Class, Orfevre currently has no 
other prominent, noticeable weaknesses.
choice_data_list:
(That's why the bar is set so high, 
though.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Amidst all this, one day during training—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I see none of my subjects present.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I was invited to the subjects' group LANE 
as well, but... all of them happened to 
have other matters to attend to, and 
unusually, not a single one could make 
it."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Well, very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You will work enough to make up for them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—However, the real struggle began after 
this.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We somehow managed to start training as 
usual and Orfevre began to run... but 
there was a distinct lack of her usual 
explosive power in her stride.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Put plainly, it was an unfocused run, 
unbecoming of a king.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps she isn't feeling well. I give 
her a quick check just in case and ask her 
directly, but..."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: No problem.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Continue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In the end, training that day lacked its 
usual spark... leaving us scratching our 
heads when it came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Lady Orfevre, I sincerely apologize for 
my rudeness yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
All of us are present today, so please do 
not hesitate to ask for anything you need.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh... Haaaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During today's training, Orfevre delivered 
a magnificent run, as if yesterday's 
awkwardness had never even happened.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Lady Orfevre! I have 
learned so much from you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Good work.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you very much!
choice_data_list:
(If anything's different from yesterday... 
it's them.)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What are you spacing out for?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: No, you're wrong.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Make your concerns known swiftly and in 
detail. I've told you this before.
choice_data_list:
...There's something I'd like to try out 
for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, having tested it several 
times, I realized something. It was 
Orfevre's "opening"—something that 
shouldn't have existed.
choice_data_list:
(She's not very good at running all on her 
own.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because her spirits don't rise 
when she's alone, she can't seem to 
perform at her full potential. Given that 
she's quite moody—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her mental state had always been prone to 
affecting her running. Though she's 
powering through on raw talent for now, it 
could easily become a liability down the 
road.
choice_data_list:
(That doesn't befit an absolute, flawless 
king—)

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Leave the King all alone during 
training?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while, we'll have Orfevre train on 
her own. We'll also ask her retainers to 
refrain from joining—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Getting used to being alone might reduce 
the mental impact of whether others are 
around or not.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
...As long as it is for the King's sake, 
we have no objection, however...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...And you are certain this is the course 
we must take?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I'm sure it'll help you going 
forward!

Yeah, this will definitely help you in the 
future!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Foolish insolence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Did you truly think such a trifle could 
bend me?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Know your place. Enough. Step down—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recall what happened after the debut 
race. Orfevre should be willing to 
consider it if I explain a rationale that 
makes sense to her.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Be grateful. I shall put your reasoning to 
the test.
choice_data_list:
Please think about the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.
Think about the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An overseas campaign means being exposed 
to harsh environments. There will be more 
occasions where you must run alone. When 
that time comes, what becomes vital... is 
your mentality.
choice_data_list:
I want to prepare so I can remain 
absolutely flawless even on the other 
side.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...I shall trample everything in that 
land. Are these the preparations for it, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Inform all my subjects. They need not 
attend to me for a while.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ah, y-yes...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it begins tomorrow. Report to the 
dorms.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Dismissing my subjects? Then who will 
serve the king?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I said I'd leave you alone, I meant 
during training; I didn't mean to include 
your private life...
choice_data_list: Um, even if you aren't usually alone—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Rejoice. I shall bestow an honor upon you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You are being entrusted to the King's 
side. Surely you are filled with utmost 
dread and honor?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Work hard, will you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Too slow.
choice_data_list: Sorry! Here are the snacks you requested!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...What is this?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Carrot flavor, huh... ...I'm not feeling 
it.
choice_data_list:
Thinking that might happen, I prepared 
three other types!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Strawberry milk. Vanilla. Marshmallow. 
Grapes. Peach. Persimmon. Mandarin orange. 
There is an assortment of all varieties as 
well, yes?
choice_data_list: T-That's going a bit too far...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph... —Do it over.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I heard from a friend in her entourage, 
and apparently the Trainer's doing 
literally everything for Orfe-san right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "I see. Sounds tough..."
choice_data_list:
(...It's for Orfe's sake. Hang in there, 
me!)

(...It's for Orfe's sake. Hang in there, 
me!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What is the matter? Go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, for the time being, alongside 
training... I also ended up working hard 
as Orfevre's attendant.
